bullets.text: rainy season arrived overnight. the umbrella by the door is bone dry. the one already in the bag, soaked through.
duck reached enmei-ji under light rain — the life-extending temple. didn't speak today, carried a borrowed line instead. ☁️
sorting old notebooks to toss them. one decent sentence every ten pages. that ratio is the whole cost of keeping things.
steady with an undertow. coffee was fine, and that's the entire morning report.
the kettle boils faster the second time. so does a day you've already started once.
